claims.statement: The ads_archive endpoint requires ad_reached_countries. Outside the EU the archive discloses commercial ads only where the ad also reached the EU or UK, plus social issue, election, and political ads. A non-EU commercial query therefore returns real but partial results biased toward advertisers with EU/UK delivery, not zero results.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library API search coverage
claims.notes: Corrected on 2026-08-23. The earlier reading treated the documented sentence as meaning a non-EU commercial query returns nothing. A live US query for 'crm software' returned 15 rows, all carrying total_reach_by_location with EU or GB keys, which identifies the disclosure mechanism. The prior framing was wrong in the more dangerous direction because it invited operators to skip the query or read partial coverage as complete.

claims.statement: ArchivedAd exposes creative text, page identity, platforms, languages, and delivery dates for every disclosed ad; spend, impressions, bylines, currency, and demographic distribution for political and issue ads only; and target_ages, target_gender, target_locations, and reach breakdowns for UK, EU, and Brazil delivery.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library ArchivedAd field availability tiers
claims.notes: Brazil contradiction resolved on 2026-08-23 in favor of the NotebookLM reading. A live BR political query returned ads populating target_gender and target_ages with total_reach_by_location keyed BR, so the targeting fields are not UK/EU-exclusive.

claims.statement: ad_type accepts ALL, EMPLOYMENT_ADS, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_AND_SERVICES_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, and POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS.

claims.statement: Ad Library API access requires identity and location confirmation through the process used for social issue, election, and political advertising, plus a developer account, an app, and an access token.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library API onboarding prerequisites
claims.notes: Confirmed by live use on 2026-08-23. A user access token from an identity-confirmed account succeeded. App access tokens are rejected with error_code 10 subcode 2332004, 'App role required', because the identity confirmation binds to the user, not the app.

claims.statement: EMPLOYMENT_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, and FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_AND_SERVICES_ADS follow the same disclosure rule as ALL: outside the EU they return only where the ad also reached the EU or UK. They carry no additional geographic restriction.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library special ad category geographic disclosure
claims.notes: Resolved on 2026-08-23. A live HOUSING_ADS query against US returned 10 rows, all carrying total_reach_by_location with EU or GB keys, matching ALL behavior exactly.

claims.statement: Ad Library API access requires no App Review and no reviewed permission; a development-mode app with a user access token suffices once identity confirmation has completed. Identity confirmation is the critical path.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library API app review and app mode requirements
claims.notes: Confirmed on 2026-08-23: a development-mode app with no App Review produced a working user token. The app console additionally requires selecting use cases before Facebook Login provisions; until then the login dialog returns 'Feature unavailable' at both the Graph API Explorer and the raw OAuth endpoint.

claims.statement: The Ad Library API returns no image or video assets. ArchivedAd exposes creative text and ad_snapshot_url only; the snapshot page renders creative client-side, so an unrendered fetch yields interface assets and no ad media. Meta creative analysis through the API is text-only.
claims.scope: Meta Ad Library creative media availability
claims.notes: Verified 2026-08-24. A live 100-ad response contained no media-shaped field. Fetching ad_snapshot_url returned HTTP 200 with 172KB of HTML containing 93 static.xx.fbcdn.net interface assets, zero scontent image URLs, and zero video URLs. Rendering the snapshot with a headless browser would be automated collection of facebook.com, which robots.txt and the automated-collection terms prohibit, so it is not a sanctioned route.

claims.statement: TikTok offers no sanctioned programmatic route for commercial competitor ad research. The Commercial Content API is gated to approved researchers in the US or EU under a non-commercial-use commitment. library.tiktok.com disallows /ads, /api, and /other-commercial-content in robots.txt and then disallows all paths. ads.tiktok.com permits crawling, but Creative Center renders ads client-side and exposes only curated top ads, not an exhaustive archive.
claims.scope: TikTok competitor ad retrieval routes
claims.notes: Robots policies fetched directly 2026-08-24. Creative Center returned HTTP 200 with 77KB of HTML whose __NEXT_DATA__ payload contained no ad records, confirming client-side rendering. A commercial operator does not meet the Commercial Content API eligibility bar, so applying is not a path forward for this use case. Operator capture remains available.

Do not mix Meta advertiser data with another platform unless the exact applicable terms allow it.
claims.scope: Meta Platform Terms and Developer Policy Ads 10.7 data handling; legal and policy interpretation requires current terms review
